meta.title: Project flow
meta.description: Five-stage gated delivery: confirm intent, plan, build, self-check, then report against the original requirements. Stages 2-4 run in isolated child agents and exchange tickets, so a long job no longer overruns one conversation. Self-healing (per-stage retries, stage deadlines, resume after a crash) and rollback (a snapshot before and after every build attempt, restored wholesale or limited to the files that attempt touched). By Liu Shi.

tool.run: Run the gated pipeline for one project
tool.resume: Continue an interrupted project from where it stopped
tool.doctor: Check stale locks, broken state and dangling stages
tool.snapshots: List snapshots and the files each build attempt touched
tool.rollback: Roll the workspace back to a snapshot, wholesale or per file
tool.models: Read the per-stage models plus self-healing and snapshot limits

command.flow: Start work mode and run the task through the five stages
command.doctor: Check the workspace, optionally repair it
